title: Remove CLEAN27 from Warehouse
summary: Removes CLEAN27 compatibility code from warehouse codeunits, tables, and reports by deleting obsolete logic no longer needed for Business Central 30.
key_points: Removes CLEAN27 compatibility code spanning 711 lines across warehouse modules
Affects activity creation, posting, registration, and warehouse entry ledger functionality
No behavioral changes for current users since compatibility code is internal technical debt
Simplifies warehouse codebase by eliminating legacy migration logic
All affected objects are internal system components
